# E1 Unico Corporation

> BBB Accredited business launch and consulting company based in Spring, Texas. E1 Unico Corporation launches real businesses and builds UnicoOS, an all-in-one Business Operating System.

E1 Unico Corporation is a SAM.gov registered federal contractor (UEI: YSEHX6CMMWA9, CAGE: 24MC6), eligible for federal, state, and local government contract awards. Available by phone evenings 7:30–9:30 PM, 7 days a week, at 1-833-E1-UNICO (1-833-318-6426). Email: Unico@E1Unico.com.

## Core Services

- [The 2K Special](https://e1unico.com/order/2k-special): $2,350 one-time — LLC or Corporation formation, EIN, Registered Agent (1 year), Logo + Brand Kit, Business Email, Google Business Profile, UnicoOS Pro (1 month free), and a 1-on-1 strategy session. Includes 1 month of UnicoCare Essential.
- [UnicoCare](https://e1unico.com/order/unicocare): Required monthly hosting and care plans, starting at $99/mo (Essential), $199/mo (Visible — local SEO), $299/mo (AI — Answer Engine Optimization / AEO so ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini can find and cite the business), and $499/mo (Pro — full done-for-you management).
- [Custom UnicoOS](https://e1unico.com/order/custom-unicoos): $2,500 setup + $2,000/mo — a fully white-labeled Business OS under the client's own brand, name, and domain.
- [Lite Website / App](https://e1unico.com/order/lite-website-app): $2,000/mo + $2,500 setup — a managed professional website or mobile-ready web app.
- [Custom Website / App](https://e1unico.com/order/custom-website-app): $10,000 + $2,500/mo maintenance — a fully custom-built website or web app.
- À la carte business launch and website services (LLC formation, EIN, logo/brand kits, Google Business setup, landing pages, e-commerce sites) and career document services (resumes, cover letters, LinkedIn optimization) are listed at https://e1unico.com/#services-store.

## UnicoOS

[UnicoOS](https://unicoos.app) is E1 Unico Corporation's all-in-one Business Operating System — CRM, invoicing, an AI receptionist (UniRo), accounting, safety, fleet management, and 100+ modules under one login. Plans range from a free personal-finance tier to $797/mo for unlimited-user enterprise use. Register at https://unicoos.app/register.

## App Ecosystem

- [All Unico Apps](https://e1unico.com/apps): One page covering the whole ecosystem — UnicoOS to run your business, UnicoJam + UnicoClip to create, UnicoMusic + UnicoTube to distribute and earn, and UnicoMobile to connect. One login, one balance.

## Other Ventures

- [UnicoJam](https://e1unico.com/unicojam): AI music studio, launching soon — turn a prompt into a finished song.
- [UnicoMusic](https://e1unico.com/unicomusic): Music streaming platform, launching soon — creators publish songs (including tracks made in UnicoJam), listeners stream free, and creators earn a share of ad revenue.
- [UnicoTube](https://e1unico.com/unicotube): Video platform, launching soon — creators upload videos (including clips made in UnicoClip), grow channels, viewers watch free, and creators earn a share of ad revenue.
- [UnicoClip](https://e1unico.com/unicoclip): Video creation studio, launching soon — turn footage, ideas, and UnicoJam tracks into short shareable videos, then publish straight to a UnicoTube channel.
- [UnicoMobile](https://e1unico.com/unicomobile): Business wireless in development (coming soon) — team phone lines designed to live inside UnicoOS, one bill and one login, tied to the CRM and UniRo AI receptionist. Carrier-neutral by design; coverage, plans, and pricing to be announced.
- [Industrial Drip](https://industrialdrip.net): PPE and safety gear e-commerce.
